$comment: Scenarios the differential harness knows about, and what has actually been
captured from real Entra. Schema mirrors azure-apim-emulator's
e2e/differential/testdata/fixture-manifest.json so the family reads the same
way; `capturedAt` and `maxAgeDays` are additions this repo needs because its
fixtures come from a live tenant rather than a recorded service.
status: planned  = named, nothing recorded, harness skips it loudly
captured = a fixture exists and is diffed on every run
A scenario is listed BEFORE it is captured on purpose. The gap between the
planned set and the captured set is the honest measure of how much
differential evidence exists, and deleting the planned rows would make an
`normalizations` is the contract between capture.sh and the harness: capture
folds these to placeholders, the harness is permitted to ignore exactly
these and nothing else. Widening it makes diffs pass — see the mutation
check in the harness, which exists because over-normalising fails silently.

scenarios.what: the app-only token envelope's field set
JWT header + claim names + structural claim values; never the token
wrong client secret — envelope, error_codes, AADSTS number
a grant_type Entra does not implement
a well-formed client_id belonging to no application
